_readme: FixMate booking settings. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE BUSINESS RULES LIVE.
Edit it, then restart the server. Nothing here is hard-coded in the code.
!! EVERYTHING MARKED confirm_before_launch:true IS A PLACEHOLDER !!
The values were NOT chosen by FixMate Services. They are examples so the
system can run at all. Opening the site for real bookings before you
correct them will show customers the wrong times. Fix these first.
opening_closed_until_YYYY_MM_DD is a safety switch: while the current date
is before that value the server refuses every booking request, so you can
set this up without accidentally taking real bookings. It is currently set
far in the future, so booking is CLOSED. When the hours below are correct,
change it to a date in the past to open.
_buffers_readme: Edge buffers, not gaps between jobs.
buffer_before_minutes: time held back at the START of each day, so the
first customer cannot start before working_hours start + this.
buffer_after_minutes: time held back at the END of each day, so the last
job must finish by working_hours end - this.

_readme: PLACEHOLDER EXAMPLE ONLY - confirm your real hours before launch.
Key = weekday. Values = one or more windows as [start, end] in 24h HH:MM.
A weekday that is absent or set to [] is closed.
Multiple windows per day is how you express breaks, e.g. lunch.
Keys: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun

service_types_readme: Allowed Type of Service values, stored as ids that match the service
group ids in data.js. Edit freely. An unknown id here is rejected by the
server, so the booking form can only ever offer services you listed.

notify._readme: n8n / Google Sheets copy. Runs AFTER the database save succeeds.
